images.name: drum
images.prompt: Create a single seamless horizontally wrapping hand-painted texture sheet for the outside of a rusty iron cement mixer drum. Flat 2D unwrapped material, NOT an object illustration. Rough loose black ink and dry-brush grain, muted rusty brick red with large weathered ochre patches, a few bold broken black construction seams. A narrow dark worn rim stripe along the top and bottom. Broad asymmetrical scrape on one side. Left and right edges match seamlessly; no vertical edge border. No directional light, highlights, cast shadows, perspective, gradients imitating a cylinder, text, bolts as separate objects, gears, icons, or background scene. The whole square is opaque material, no transparent gaps. Designed to be readable when wrapped on a small game drum. Hell Workers rough ink illustration style, tactile but sparse.

images.name: iron
images.prompt: Create a single seamless square hand-painted dark weathered iron material texture for narrow chassis rails, posts and wheel hubs of a grim construction-site mixer. Flat material sheet, NOT an object illustration. Strong hand-ink illustration language with dry grain, charcoal gray steel, a few broad desaturated rusty brown scuffs and muted pale worn marks. Sparse purposeful ink scratches; no tiny busy noise. No directional lighting, bevel highlights, cast shadows, perspective, text, icons, geometry, borders, or objects. Opaque edge to edge. Suitable for small 2.5D hand-drawn game props.

images.name: canvas
images.prompt: Create a single seamless square hand-painted worn canvas cloth material texture for a small enclosed construction-site rest tent in a grim whimsical game. Flat 2D material sheet, NOT a tent illustration. Muted dusty warm gray-brown canvas with restrained cool mauve cloth, dry brush grain, one large irregular ochre cloth repair patch stitched on with a few thick loose black stitches, two broad wobbly black sewn joins. Plenty of quiet flat cloth area; no photoreal fine weave. No directional lighting, smooth shading, cast shadows, perspective, folds pretending to be a 3D object, letters, labels, glyphs, icons, poles or background. No rectangular frame; seamless edges in both directions. Opaque full square. Rough hand-drawn ink and broad matte color planes.
